title: 3-in-1 Fishing Hook Remover & Knot Tying Tool (2 Pack, Red + Blue)
description: Deep-swallowed hooks, fiddly hook snells and slipping leader knots - this pocket-size 3-in-1 tool handles all three, so you spend less time wrestling with tackle and more time with a line in the water. title: Hatch Match Soft Fly Bait, 5 pc Pre-Rigged Hooked Insect Lure for Trout & Panfish
description: A lifelike soft-plastic fly that floats in the film and twitches like a real insect that just hit the water. Each one comes pre-rigged on a sharp hook, so you can tie on and start casting to rising fish right away. Realistic fly profile , segmented body, veined wings, legs and glitter flakes that catch light the way a real fly does. Hook already set , a fine-wire hook molded into the body with an eye at the head, no rigging or glue needed. Soft, natural bite feel , the pliable plastic body makes fish hold on longer instead of spitting it out. Three micro sizes , Small 11 mm, Medium 17 mm and Large 21 mm to match the hatch and the fish you are after. Light enough to drift , from 0.07 g to 0.37 g, ideal for ultralight spinning with a float, bubble or fly rod. 5 pieces per pack , one color and one size per pack, in Black, Olive Brown, Clear Green, Rusty Red or Golden Yellow. Targets , trout, chub, dace, panfish, bluegill, carp and other surface-feeding fish in streams and ponds.

Each one comes pre-rigged on a sharp hook, so you can tie on and start casting to rising fish right away. Realistic fly profile , segmented body, veined wings, legs and glitter flakes that catch light the way a real fly does. Hook already set , a fine-wire hook molded into the body with an eye at the head, no rigging or glue needed. Soft, natural bite feel , the pliable plastic body makes fish hold on longer instead of spitting it out. Three micro sizes , Small 11 mm, Medium 17 mm and Large 21 mm to match the hatch and the fish you are after. Light enough to drift , from 0.07 g to 0.37 g, ideal for ultralight spinning with a float, bubble or fly rod. 5 pieces per pack , one color and one size per pack, in Black, Olive Brown, Clear Green, Rusty Red or Golden Yellow. Targets , trout, chub, dace, panfish, bluegill, carp and other surface-feeding fish in streams and ponds.

title: Metal Jig Fishing Lures Set Sinking Hard Fishing Bait Set
description: Stop letting trophy fish stay just out of reach. Engineered for extreme distance and realistic fluid action, this holographic metal jigging spoon set is your ticket to covering more water and triggering aggressive reaction strikes. Whether you are casting from the shore, jigging over deep structures, or working the flats, these versatile micro jigs mimic panicked baitfish to perfection. Featuring an aerodynamic, stream-lined profile, this sinking hard fishing bait set cuts through heavy winds, letting you achieve maximum distance on every single launch. Why Serious Anglers Keep This Jig Kit in Their Tackle Box: Extreme Long-Casting Performance: Designed with a rear-weighted, aerodynamic profile that maximizes momentum for unmatched distance, making it the ultimate setup for bank and shore fishermen. Dual-Hook Rigging Configuration: Equipped with a high-strength, rust-resistant feathered assist hook at the head to mimic natural gills, paired with an ultra-sharp rear treble hook to guarantee solid hookups. Holographic Flash Finish: Every jig features a multi-angle laser coating that reflects light dynamically underwater, accurately simulating the shimmering scales of fleeing minnows. Irresistible Sinking Action: Drops with a erratic, high-frequency flutter on the fall, remaining in the strike zone longer to entice finicky bass, trout, walleye, and perch. Specifications: Bait Type: Sinking Metal Jig / Jigging Spoon / Micro Spoon Weight Variations: Available in 7g (45mm), 10g (48mm), 15g (55mm), 20g (60mm), and 25g (65mm) Hook Setup: 1 x Feathered Assist Single Hook (Front) + 1 x High-Carbon Steel Treble Hook (Rear) Target Species: Bass (Largemouth & Smallmouth), Trout, Perch, Crappie, Pike, Walleye, Stripers, and more. Environment: Formulated for freshwater streams and lakes, as well as light saltwater coastal fishing.

title: MicroVibe Metal Blade Bait, 3g / 6g Mini VIB Lure for Panfish, Trout & Bass
description: Small bait, big vibration. The MicroVibe packs a tight, fish-calling shimmy into a body barely bigger than a fingertip, so it gets bit when bigger lures get ignored. Front-weighted body , the center of gravity sits forward so it sinks fast, swims nose-down and rides up over snags instead of digging in. Twin line holes on the back , clip the front hole for a fast, tight wobble or the rear hole for a wider, slower roll. Lead-copper core , a solid copper insert resists corrosion and keeps the bait heavy for its size for longer casts. Laser finish + 3D eyes , flashes like a fleeing baitfish in clear or stained water. Single hook with flash skirt , a sharp single hook with a tinsel tail adds movement on the drop and makes unhooking easy. Two micro sizes , 3g (2cm) for ultralight finesse and 6g (2.7cm) for extra casting distance and deeper water. Five colors , Laser Red, Laser Gold, Laser Blue, Green Back Yellow and Pink Back White.

title: SnagGuard Shrimp Rig Bundle, 10 Hooked Boat Jig Heads + 10 Floating Shrimp Soft Baits (Dark Red)
description: Ready-to-fish shrimp rigs that crawl through cover. Keep away from children and wash hands after handling.

title: SoftBite Rubber-Coated Split Shot Sinkers, 30 pc Bite-On Removable Weights Kit
description: Split shot that won't chew up your line. Each SoftBite weight has a soft rubber lining, so it grips tight without nicking mono or braid, and slides off cleanly when you change your rig. Line-safe rubber coating , the soft inner layer cushions the line so it doesn't crimp, kink or weaken under pressure. Bite on, peel off, reuse , the open-mouth design pinches on with your fingers or pliers and opens again for repositioning, no wasted shot. Three sizes per box , every kit holds 30 pieces: 10 each of three neighbouring sizes, so you can fine-tune float balance and sink rate on the water. Color-coded by size , bright coatings make it easy to tell sizes apart and spot a dropped shot on the deck. Eight size sets , from ultralight G2 + G1 + B (0.4 to 0.5 g) for float fishing and panfish, up to 6B + 7B + 8B (2.4 to 3.2 g) for current, deeper water and bigger baits. Clear storage box , a compact compartment case keeps sizes sorted in your tackle bag. Contains lead. Keep away from children and wash hands after handling.
